decision_reasons.ETHUSDT: ETH remains protected just below its 96h low. Short-term returns and EMA slopes are negative, but the daily return is positive and 24h efficiency is low, favoring a hold over exit or addition.
decision_reasons.HYPEUSDT: HYPE has a tentative 1h bounce and taker-buy share slightly above 0.50, but remains below the lower Bollinger band, EMA20, and VWAP with negative 6h-1d returns. Retain the protected core without adding until the bounce confirms.
decision_reasons.MUUSDT: No position is open. Price is below the lower Bollinger band, EMA20, and VWAP while 6h and 24h returns remain sharply negative. Oversold geometry alone is not confirmation, so wait for a closed-bar stabilization rather than catching the decline.
decision_reasons.SNDKUSDT: The core recovery thesis is invalidated: 24h and daily returns are approximately -11.1% and -10.2%, both EMA slopes are sharply negative, and price is below EMA20 and 24h VWAP. Exit rather than add at a fresh 96h low; a future reentry requires new evidence.
decision_reasons.SOLUSDT: SOL is below its lower Bollinger band, EMA20, and VWAP, with negative returns and elevated volume. The protected core may be retained because the stop remains below the 96h low, but adding or tightening into current noise has poor utility.

wait_reasons.MUUSDT: Wait for the next closed 1h bars to show stabilization—preferably two closes above 794.29 and a nonnegative 6h return. Current oversold observations do not establish reversal.

decision_reasons.BTCUSDT: The core remains protected and the range thesis is intact, but directional efficiency is extremely low and both EMA slopes remain slightly negative. Trailing the stop from 62768.58 to 63065.71 reduces downside exposure without adding risk.
decision_reasons.ETHUSDT: ETH is holding above its protected support, but the recovery thesis is weakened and the directionless path remains supported. Raising the stop from 1856.03 to 1865.49 preserves the core while reducing exposure below the recent low.
decision_reasons.HYPEUSDT: The protected core can remain open because the stop has not been invalidated, but no add is justified: 6h and 24h returns are negative, downside efficiency is elevated, and price remains below falling EMA and VWAP observations. The calculated new stop is below the existing stop, so trailing offers no improvement.
decision_reasons.MUUSDT: Although OPEN_CORE narrowly passes hard limits, downside momentum remains efficient and broad: the 6h return is -7.08%, the 24h return is -13.35%, both EMA slopes are negative, and price is below the lower Bollinger band. Waiting has higher relative utility than catching the decline.
decision_reasons.SNDKUSDT: WAIT is the only hard-feasible action. The proposed core entry is vetoed by MAX_TRADE_RISK, while the 24h and daily declines, falling EMAs, and sub-0.50 taker-buy share continue to support downside-test risk.
decision_reasons.SOLUSDT: The bounce has not invalidated the supported downside-test path: the 24h return remains negative, both EMA slopes fall, and taker-buy share is below 0.50. Trailing the stop from 71.63 to 72.09 reduces exposure while allowing the protected core to remain open.

wait_reasons.MUUSDT: Relative-utility veto: require stabilization above the lower-band region and loss of downside efficiency before allocating nearly 0.5% equity risk.
wait_reasons.SNDKUSDT: Hard risk veto: OPEN_CORE is rejected for MAX_TRADE_RISK, and no other active action is feasible.

decision_reasons.BTCUSDT: Hold the protected core. BTC has small positive short-horizon returns and balanced taker flow, but extremely low efficiency and a nearly flat-to-falling EMA structure argue against adding. The existing stop already limits risk.
decision_reasons.ETHUSDT: Hold the protected core. ETH is slightly above EMA20 and VWAP24 with positive 1h, 6h, and daily observations, supporting continued ownership; very low 24h efficiency and flat higher-timeframe movement do not support adding.
decision_reasons.HYPEUSDT: Trail the protected core. HYPE remains below EMA20 and VWAP24 with negative 6h, 24h, 4h, and daily returns. Positive one-hour flow supports retaining exposure, but the stronger downside evidence favors tighter protection rather than an add.
decision_reasons.MUUSDT: Wait. MU remains below EMA20 and VWAP24 with negative 6h, 24h, 4h, and daily returns. Positive taker share and a one-hour bounce are insufficient to outweigh the high-efficiency six-hour decline.
decision_reasons.SNDKUSDT: Wait. The 1h bounce does not offset negative 6h, 24h, daily, and EMA-slope observations; price also remains below EMA20 and VWAP24. Opening now has the largest incremental risk cost in the set without confirmation of a durable reversal.
decision_reasons.SOLUSDT: Trail the protected core. SOL has recovered above EMA20/VWAP24 with positive 1h, 6h, and 24h returns, but efficiency remains very low and EMA slopes remain negative. Raising protection captures the improved level without paying for an add.

wait_reasons.MUUSDT: Relative utility is inadequate: downside momentum remains supported, and the available rebound evidence does not justify adding 34.11 USDT of risk.
wait_reasons.SNDKUSDT: Relative utility is inferior to preserving risk: the bounce lacks trend confirmation, price remains below EMA20/VWAP24, and OPEN_CORE consumes 44.44 USDT of additional risk.

decision_reasons.BTCUSDT: Hold the protected BTC core without adding. Price remains inside the established range, 24h return is nearly flat, and directional efficiency is very low. There is neither invalidation evidence nor sufficient confirmation for additional exposure.
decision_reasons.ETHUSDT: Hold the protected ETH core. The positive 4h return and price near EMA20 support the recovery path, but negative 6h/24h returns and very low efficiency do not justify an add or a tighter trail yet.
decision_reasons.HYPEUSDT: Trail the protected HYPE core because it has the weakest holding profile: negative 6h and 24h returns, falling EMA slopes, and price below EMA20/VWAP24. Strong taker-buy share prevents outright invalidation, but downside protection has higher utility than adding.
decision_reasons.MUUSDT: Wait. MU has the weakest 24h return in the universe, negative EMA slopes, and price below EMA20/VWAP24. Although OPEN_CORE is hard-feasible, its 34.78 USDT incremental risk is not justified before stabilization or recovery confirmation.
decision_reasons.SNDKUSDT: Wait. SNDK remains below EMA20 and VWAP24 after a 9.89% 24h decline, with both EMA slopes negative. Its feasible entry would add 48.43 USDT—the largest incremental risk—so its relative utility is inferior to preserving capacity until reversal evidence appears.
decision_reasons.SOLUSDT: Hold the protected SOL core. Support remains intact and the positive 4h return supports a retest of 74.50, but low efficiency and negative EMA slopes argue against adding exposure.

decision_reasons.ETHUSDT: Keep the core with tighter protection. Support and the positive closed 4h return preserve the recovery case, but negative 1h/24h returns, weak taker buying, and declining EMAs argue against adding.
decision_reasons.HYPEUSDT: Trail the core because HYPE has the weakest active-position profile: negative 6h, 24h, and daily returns plus falling EMAs, while the recovery path remains only weakly supported. The recent low has not yet been conclusively broken.

decision_reasons.SNDKUSDT: Remain flat. The dominant observations are negative 6h, 24h, and daily returns with falling EMA slopes; the only proposed entry breaches the per-trade risk limit.
decision_reasons.SOLUSDT: Maintain the core with a trail beneath support. The positive closed 4h return supports a retest of 74.50, but negative short-horizon returns, weak taker buying, and declining EMAs make an add unattractive.
